name: guardrails
description: Harness-enforced safety rails for agentic sessions: a containment hook that keeps writes inside the project and blocks network/privilege/deploy commands and pushes to off-machine remotes, an audit hook that records every tool call, and an opt-in Stop gate that refuses to let an agent finish on a red build. Enforcement lives in hooks rather than prompts, so it holds when the model is wrong. Fails closed by design — a crashed containment hook denies rather than allows. Not a replacement for permission rules: plugins cannot ship permissions, and the two layers cover different failure modes.
